name: rain-bars
title: Rain Bars
description: A short rain forecast: bars hang from a band and reach down in turn while a few drops keep falling.

perf.budget: Bars use short UI-thread springs on arrival. Five small drop views loop on the UI thread, so it animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Bars appear in place and no drops fall.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { RainBars } from '@/components/kinetik/rain-bars';

<RainBars
  title="Steady Rain"
  total={19}
  amounts={[3, 5, 8, 6, 9, 12, 16, 11, 7, 10, 14, 18, 15, 9, 6, 8, 12, 17, 13, 8, 5, 7, 4, 3]}
  times={['NOW', '12:30', '13:00', '13:30']}
/>;
```

## When to use

- The next hour or two of rain in a weather app.
- Any short forecast where the shape over time matters.

## When not to use

- Long forecasts: the bars get too thin past about 40.
- Exact amounts per period. There is no scale.

## Notes

- The first bar is now and is drawn in white.
- Times are spread evenly under the bars.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add rain-bars`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
